sents.en: Boats travel on water.
They are used on lakes, rivers, and oceans.
The body of a boat is called the hull.
The front of a boat is the bow.
The back is the stern.
There are many kinds of boats.
Boats can be used for traveling, fishing, or just for fun.
Motorboats come in many sizes.
They can be used for fishing, waterskiing, or cruising.
Big fishing boats use nets to catch fish.
They can stay out at sea for weeks at a time.
sents.ko: 한 번에 몇 주씩 바다에 머물 수 있어요.

sents.en: Racing boats are made for speed.
Some go as fast as 150 mph (240 km/h)!
Ferryboats carry people and cars.
Some people ride ferryboats to work.
sents.ko: 어떤 사람들은 여객선을 타고 일하러 가요.

sents.en: Sailboats have big sails that catch the wind.
sents.ko: 돛배에는 바람을 받는 큰 돛이 있어요.

sents.en: Moving the rudder guides the boat.
Kayaks and canoes can be fun to use.
Paddles are used to move these boats.
Wow! Many different types of boats.
This book makes me want to go on a boat, and go swimming.
sents.ko: 이 책을 보니 배도 타고 수영도 하고 싶어져요.

sents.en: Looks really fun.
Okay. I'll see you next time.
I'm gonna go swimming.
